description: This file defines a custom deck.gl layer for screengrid visualization, including functions for generating tooltips, creating layers, and handling hover interactions. It also exports a component for rendering the screengrid layer with optional highlighting.

methods.name: getPoints
methods.description: Extracts position points from data array.

methods.name: defaultTooltipGenerator
methods.description: Generates tooltip content for screengrid layer, including centroid, coordinates, weight, cell weight, and sample points.
